rows.text: Charged $29.98 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Halcyon Threshold: evaluation mapping project". It read: "Hi Priya, Thanks so much for offering to help with Halcyon Threshold. I have a concrete project that would be perfect for your data analyst skills and 5 hours/week. **Project: Map the AI Safety Evaluation Landscape** We're trying to understand what's being systematically measured and evaluated in AI safety, and what's neglected. Your task: 1. **Research**: Who is doing what evaluations? (big labs, academia, independent researchers, governments) 2. **Categorize**: What domains are well-covered? (training robustness, alignment metrics, interpretability, others?) What's thin? 3. **Document**: Build a simple database/spreadsheet showing: evaluation type → who's doing it → what gaps exist 4. **Deliverable**: 5-10 page analysis with recommendations on what evaluation work looks most neglected Timeline: 3-4 weeks, ~5 hrs/week This will directly inform our work and help us identify where we can have the most impact. Interested? Best, Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Volunteer deployed: Priya Raman working on evaluation landscape mapping

rows.text: Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tomasz Wrona <twrona@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Input sought: evaluation gaps in AI safety". It read: "Hi Tomasz, We met at the meetup last week. I'm working on a project to identify the most critical evaluation gaps in AI safety research—work that's clearly needed but isn't being funded well. I'm looking at three areas from the AI Safety Directory: 1. Independent replication of safety results 2. Autonomous agent evaluation frameworks 3. Cross-lab safety protocols Before we commit to funding work in these areas, I'd love your quick thoughts: - Are these actually the most neglected gaps from a governance perspective? - Who do you know who's been frustrated about not being able to do work in these areas? - Any blind spots you'd push back on? We're building a grants program and want to point capital at the right problems. Your input would be valuable. Best, Halcyon Threshold"

Asking because we're trying to understand where evaluation funding would have the most impact. Thanks, Halcyon Threshold"
